# Papers

76 papers, grouped by the layer of the [stack](../../layers/README.md) they mainly touch. Dates are arXiv UTC dates: first version / latest version. **Read** says how much we read: `full` and `partial` mean we read the paper's method and results; `abstract` means the abstract only, so treat the summary as a pointer, not a review; `card` means a machine-extracted [method card](../cards/index.md) whose quotes a program checked against the paper text (the gloss has not been checked by a person). ⭐ marks essential reading.
